description: This file declares functions and includes related to WiFi WPA Supplicant management, such as initialization, cleanup, starting/stopping daemon, and configuration. It contains function prototypes and macro guards, serving as a header for specific WiFi functionality in the project.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_init
methods.description: Initializes the WPA Supplicant component for the given endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the WPA Supplicant for the given endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_startDaemon
methods.description: Starts the WPA Supplicant daemon for the specified endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_reloadDaemon
methods.description: Reloads or restarts the WPA Supplicant daemon.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes or updates the WPA Supplicant configuration for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant daemon is currently running.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant process is alive.
